plans.idea: Faithful vertical restack of the original: centred logo lockup on top, bottle hero, then headline and subcopy, with a full-width CTA anchoring the bottom, so it reads top-to-bottom like a skyscraper. It fixes the current tiny off-axis logo and the dead space at the top.

Headline-first story: a big 'Sip the Solstice' stack opens the column, the bottle sits in the middle as proof, the CTA follows directly under it, and the logo signs off at the bottom like an end card.

Brand-then-message header: the logo and headline/subcopy form one grouped top block, the bottle fills the lower middle, and the CTA sits right beneath the product, so the eye lands on the product and then on the action.
